description: Figures the README states about related projects, where the README is README.md and the pages scripts/check_readme_claims.py reads with it (its PAGES). They are measured in those projects, not in matrix.json, so each is pinned here with the release it was read from, and for DVAA the commit. scripts/check_readme_claims.py fails when a README line states a different number in one of the wordings the script reads; a figure worded any other way is not checked. For DVAA the wordings are read on a README line naming DVAA: 'N agents', 'N deliberately vulnerable', 'N hardened reference', 'N control-protected variant(s)', 'N vulnerable agent(s)' and 'N categories' (up to two words, each a run of ASCII letters and hyphens, may stand between the number and 'categories'), each read in any letter case with one space between words. For HackMyAgent the wordings are 'N static checks' and 'N payloads' or 'N attack payloads', and for OASB 'N controls' and 'N domains', each read on every README line in the letter case written here. A README line naming DVAA that carries a format character (Unicode category Cf), a control character (category Cc) other than a tab, a Hangul filler, a combining mark Unicode lists as default ignorable or a code point Unicode lists as default ignorable without assigning it fails, because such a character can keep a figure from being read. Re-measure with the refresh command when the project releases.

dvaa.source: README.md: the Security column of the Agents table, and the rows of the Attack Categories table
dvaa.refresh: curl -s https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opena2a-org/damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/main/README.md | grep -E "^\| [A-Za-z-]+ \| 70[0-9]{2} \|" | awk -F'|' '{gsub(/ /,"",$4); print $4}' | sort | uniq -c

oasb.source: OASB-1 1.0.0 as bundled in the hackmyagent 0.33.2 npm package

readWith.controls: sum of controls over OASB_1_CATEGORIES exported by hackmyagent@0.33.2 dist/benchmarks/oasb-1.js
